messages.text: Is the Kora Logistics SOW v3 ready for me to approve?

Yes, it has reached your step. The PM and the PMO Lead have both approved it. The stage amounts follow costing v3 and the plan has four stages. One thing to know: the client has not yet confirmed the go-live date, so the last stage shows its date as unknown. You decide; I cannot approve for you.
